from.place: proof, invocation of Theorem 09YQ in degree zero for sheaves of sets: the colimit of sections over a limit of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, including the reduction from affine objects to a finite affine cover

title: Continuity of etale sections for sheaves of sets
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(X_i,f_{i'i})_{i\le i'}$ be an inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ with projections $f_i:X\to X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $G$ be a sheaf of sets on $(X_0)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $W_0\to X_0$ be etale and of finite presentation, put $W_i=W_0\times_{X_0}X_i$ and $W=W_0\times_{X_0}X$, and write $\rho_{i'i}:(f_{i0}^{-1}G)(W_i)\to(f_{i'0}^{-1}G)(W_{i'})$ for the transition map obtained from the unit of inverse image, the composition isomorphism $c$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and restriction along the canonical iterated-fibre-product isomorphism. Then $\rho_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, $\rho_{i''i'}\circ\rho_{i'i}=\rho_{i''i}$, and the canonical map $$\varinjlim_i(f_{i0}^{-1}G)(W_i)\;\longrightarrow\;(f_0^{-1}G)(W)$$ is a bijection. In particular, for the etale projection $\operatorname{pr}_i:W_i\to X_i$, restriction identifies $(\operatorname{pr}_i^{-1}f_{i0}^{-1}G)(W_i)$ with $(f_{i0}^{-1}G)(W_i)$.
